# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest version on the default branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose security issues publicly in GitHub Issues.

Report vulnerabilities by opening a private security advisory in GitHub:
- Go to the Security tab of this repository.
- Use "Report a vulnerability".

If private reporting is not available, contact the maintainer directly and include:
- Affected version or commit
- Reproduction steps
- Impact assessment
- Suggested remediation (if known)
